candidates.summary: Only five Latvian companies made Coface’s CEE Top 500 ranking, compared with 10 from Estonia and 23 from Lithuania, highlighting Latvia’s limited representation among the region’s largest businesses.

candidates.title: New Finance Minister Purgailis: Latvia should review personal income tax relief
candidates.summary: Latvia’s new Finance Minister Kārlis Purgailis proposes reviewing tax relief for savings, education and healthcare, alongside potentially removing exemptions on smaller gambling winnings.

candidates.title: US intelligence chief: Putin is no friend to Americans
candidates.summary: The US President has called the Russian dictator a friend, yet not everyone supports his characterization.

candidates.title: Up to two centimetres of snow expected in parts of Latvia as roads turn slippery
candidates.summary: Snow, freezing rain and slippery roads are expected across Latvia this week, with overnight temperatures potentially dropping to minus seven degrees.

candidates.title: BNN in Focus | "One of the most cynical post-election episodes in Latvia's history" – Rajevskis sharply criticises Unity
candidates.summary: Political scientist Filips Rajevskis sharply criticises New Unity's refusal to support the Kulbergs government, calling its post-election conduct exceptionally cynical.

candidates.title: Estonia to close all land border crossings with Russia
candidates.summary: Estonia will close all land border crossings with Russia from 1 December, citing security threats and Russian-linked sabotage attacks, while maintaining rail freight operations.

candidates.title: Two Russian missiles and a jet-powered drone crash in Poland
candidates.summary: Poland reports that two Russian missiles and a jet-powered drone crashed on its territory during a major Russian attack on Ukraine.

candidates.title: Latvia fails to fully implement EU requirements – Eurovignette shortcomings could lead to legal action and penalties
candidates.summary: Latvia has two months to address shortcomings in implementing the Eurovignette Directive or risk EU court proceedings and financial penalties.

candidates.title: De-Russification in Latvia – Culture Minister explains plans to eliminate Russian from public institutions' communications
candidates.summary: Latvia's Culture Minister Nauris Puntulis calls for ending Russian-language communications in public institutions as the government prepares a legal framework for de-Russification.

candidates.title: Snow expected this weekend – freezing temperatures and slippery roads ahead in Latvia
candidates.summary: Latvia faces its first wintry weekend, with snow, overnight frost and slippery roads expected as temperatures fall below freezing.

candidates.title: Former Riga Deputy Mayor sentenced to three years in prison for demanding a bribe
candidates.summary: Former Riga Deputy Mayor Andris Ameriks has been sentenced to three years in prison for demanding a large bribe, although the judgment remains subject to appeal.

candidates.title: "We are making history" – what did Trump, Putin and Xi discuss in China?
candidates.summary: Trump, Putin and Xi held trilateral talks in China on Ukraine, nuclear weapons and global security, issuing a joint declaration on international cooperation.

candidates.title: Kulbergs' government plans to abolish Climate and Energy Ministry, but process could take several months
candidates.summary: Latvia's new government plans to abolish the Ministry of Climate and Energy, although the process could take several month.

candidates.title: Latvia could raise minimum alcohol purchasing age to 20 – Health Ministry proposes new restrictions
candidates.summary: Latvia's Health Ministry proposes raising the alcohol purchasing age to 20 from 2028, banning advertising and petrol station sales, and introducing stricter labelling requirements.

candidates.title: One year as Latvia's Prosecutor General – what has Meisters achieved and what changes lie ahead?
candidates.summary: After a year in office, Prosecutor General Armīns Meisters highlights major reforms, nearly 5.5 million euros in reduced planned expenditure and further modernisation plans.

candidates.title: Ukraine launches another strike on Crimean Bridge
candidates.summary: Ukraine reportedly launched a third strike on the Crimean Bridge this week, targeting its railway section after earlier attacks destroyed part of the road bridge.

candidates.title: Wintry weather ahead in Latvia – sleet and temperatures as low as minus two degrees expected this weekend
candidates.summary: Latvia is set for colder, wetter weather, with sleet, gusty winds and overnight temperatures dropping to minus two degrees this weekend.

candidates.title: "Uļa" becomes Latvia's most-watched film of 2026
candidates.summary: Uļa" has become Latvia's most-watched film of 2026, attracting over 112,000 viewers and gaining international recognition.

candidates.title: Tartu City's budget to rise by 4 percent in 2027
candidates.summary: Tartu City Government submitted the city's €365.5 million draft budget for next year to the city council, an increase of 4 percent from this year. Child benefits will also rise.

candidates.title: Central bank: People in Estonia taking on larger home loans relative to income
candidates.summary: Average loan amounts and incomes have risen, but debt burdens are growing faster, showing people are borrowing more relative to their incomes, the Bank of Estonia (Eesti Pank) said.

candidates.title: MPs draft legislation to stop tax breaks for online casinos
candidates.summary: New legislation drafted by the Riigikogu's Finance Committee will cancel future reductions in gambling tax rates, and set the limit at 5.5 percent.

candidates.title: Developer drops Haapsalu wind farm plans
candidates.summary: Haapsalu 1 Energiapark OÜ, which had planned to build a wind farm in the villages of Käpla, Jõõdre, Lannuste, Vätse, Haeska and Ammuta, has informed the Haapsalu city government that it is abandoning the project.

candidates.title: Estonian PM: Closing rail border crossing with Russia could be next step
candidates.summary: Prime Minister Kristen Michal said Estonia's decision to close its land border with Russia is effectively indefinite and designed to withstand legal challenges. The government has not yet decided whether to close the rail border crossing, but Michal said that option could be considered as a future step.

candidates.title: Data center grid requests exceed Estonia's peak power demand several times over
candidates.summary: Transmission grid operator Elering says data center connection requests have hit 3,300 megawatts — nearly twice Estonia's peak electricity demand — straining grid limits.

candidates.title: Government to offset district heating and network fees during winter
candidates.summary: The government has decided to cushion the impact of high energy prices during the heating season by compensating part of district heating costs and reducing electricity and gas network charges for consumers.

candidates.title: President Alar Karis: Chance has played an important role in my life
candidates.summary: President Alar Karis said that he met the love of his life in ninth grade and acknowledged that his entire life has been shaped by chance. He also said that Raadi Cemetery was one of the most significant places of his childhood and adolescence.

candidates.title: Interior ministry: Christian Orthodox Church must remove metropolitan from office
candidates.summary: The Ministry of the Interior said in a letter to the Estonian Christian Orthodox Church (EKÕK) that the church must bring its board into compliance with the law and remove Metropolitan Eugene from it.

candidates.title: Tallinn Zoo director resigns after serious differences with department chiefs
candidates.summary: Tallinn Zoo Director Kaupo Heinma will step down early next year amid a management crisis that has prompted calls for structural reform and political accountability.

candidates.title: Former Narva council chair named suspect in criminal case
candidates.summary: Former Narva City Council Chair Mihhail Stalnuhhin has been named a suspect in an influence-peddling investigation, the Prosecutor's Office said.

candidates.title: Teachers' pay dispute ends without agreement
candidates.summary: Mediation talks between the Estonian Education Personnel Union (EHL) and the Ministry of Education over teachers' pay for next year ended without an agreement, giving the union the legal right to strike in 2027 if additional funding is not secured.

candidates.title: Hiiumaa to pay lion's share of childbirth benefit before birth
candidates.summary: Hiiumaa municipality plans to increase its childbirth benefit to €1,000 and pay most of it out during the seventh month of pregnancy, helping families cover travel and accommodation costs now that they must leave the island for planned births.

candidates.title: Central bank: Financial risks could drive up borrowing costs
candidates.summary: Risks to Estonia's financial system have increased due to rising energy prices, higher interest rates and rapid growth in real estate lending, which could make borrowing more expensive and create repayment difficulties for households and businesses, Eesti Pank said in its latest financial stability review.

candidates.title: State-funded AI training may be led by people without relevant expertise
candidates.summary: A person leading a state-funded artificial intelligence training course may not necessarily have formal skills or qualifications in the field, despite requirements for training providers.

candidates.title: Estonia backs EU's 22nd Russia sanctions package, fighter visa ban
candidates.summary: Foreign Minister Margus Tsahkna (Eesti 200) welcomed the European Commission's 22nd Russia sanctions package Monday, which proposes a Schengen visa ban on Russian war veterans.

candidates.title: Gallery: Tartu's Sõpruse Bridge reopens after 2-year renovation
candidates.summary: Both sides of Tartu's Sõpruse Bridge will reopen to traffic on Tuesday afternoon, after a two-year renovation that has cost almost €20.5 million.

candidates.title: Kuldar Leis: Housing shortage is holding back regional growth
candidates.summary: There are places in Estonia where people want to live and businesses want to grow, yet the lack of suitable housing stands in the way of both, writes Kuldar Leis.

candidates.title: Tickets on sale for Estonia-Romania Nations League home leg, away restrictions set
candidates.summary: Tickets went on sale Tuesday for Estonia's UEFA Nations League playoff first leg against Romania at Tallinn's A. Le Coq Arena in late March.

candidates.title: Expert: Europe can no longer win the broader artificial intelligence race
candidates.summary: The U.S. economy has become increasingly dependent on continued investment in AI, while Europe's reliance on U.S. technology is worrying, Peter Priisalm tells ERR in an interview.

candidates.title: Pipedrive commits to laying off 236 in Estonia
candidates.summary: Sales software developer Pipedrive has notified the Estonian Unemployment Insurance Fund that 236 employees will lose their jobs as part of a collective layoff.

candidates.title: Legendary Tallinn nightclub finally closes doors after over 30 years in business
candidates.summary: Noted Tallinn nightclub Club Hollywood has closed permanently after 31 years in business following the expiration of its lease, club manager Rauno Otsepp told ERR.

candidates.title: Expert: Violence is a learned behavior, not inevitable
candidates.summary: Domestic violence prevention expert Hannaliisa Uusma said that violence is passed down from generation to generation, but violent behavior remains a matter of individual choice. Estonia lacks a support system for helping perpetrators stop being violent, she noted.

candidates.title: Relative poverty up among families with children in Estonia
candidates.summary: Nineteen percent of Estonia's population lived in relative poverty last year, with the rate rising among families with children. Of households with children, single-parent families experience inequality most acutely.

candidates.title: Shortcomings found in staffing and work organization of nursing homes
candidates.summary: Staffing shortages, failures to follow individual care plans and outdated employee records are among the main shortcomings identified during nursing home inspections in Estonia this year.

candidates.title: Man, 50, dies after falling from e-scooter in Tallinn
candidates.summary: A 50-year-old man died Tuesday morning in Tallinn after falling from anelectric scooter on Ehitajate tee, police said.

candidates.title: Estonian church mails Christmas messages from Hong Kong to save money
candidates.summary: Sending Christmas cards is more expensive again this year, prompting some Estonians to look for creative alternatives. One congregation found a solution thousands of miles away in Hong Kong.

candidates.title: Broken things just need some love and attention
candidates.summary: As consumer goods become increasingly disposable and difficult to repair, researchers and designers are calling for a renewed culture of mending that could help people reconnect with their possessions and reduce waste.

candidates.title: Kremlin again accuses Estonia of letting Ukraine attack via its airspace
candidates.summary: Russia's Foreign Ministry claimed Monday that Estonia is "tacitly" allowing Ukraine to use its airspace to strike targets inside Russia.

candidates.title: Ille Nakurt-Murumaa: Everyone wants a hand in entrepreneurs' pockets, including private health care
candidates.summary: Estonian entrepreneurs are facing growing pressure from both labor unions seeking minimum wage increases above economic growth and private health care providers pushing for expanded occupational health requirements that would increase employers' costs, argues Ille Nakurt-Murumaa.

candidates.title: Government greenlights new Pelguranna tram corridor
candidates.summary: Infrastructure Minister Kuldar Leis has approved the revised Pelguranna tram line project, allowing Tallinn to move forward with construction. The new tram line is expected to be completed in 2029.

candidates.title: Opposition stalls 2027 budget and climate law debates
candidates.summary: The Riigikogu's opposition parties on Monday blocked approval of agendas in both the Finance Committee and the Environment Committee, delaying discussions on the 2027 state budget and the climate law.

candidates.title: Social Affairs Minister Karmen Joller resigns
candidates.summary: Social Affairs Minister Karmen Joller of the Reform Party announced in parliament Monday that she is stepping down from her post after acknowledging a legal violation involving a company board position.

candidates.title: Estonia launches multinational exercise with UK and French forces
candidates.summary: Exercise Pikne 2026 begins in Estonia on November 23, bringing together the Estonian Defense Forces, the Estonian Defense League and allied troops from France and the United Kingdom for three weeks of training.

candidates.title: Court rejects early release request of woman who killed her baby
candidates.summary: Harju District Court has denied early release to Kairi Kuusemaa, who is serving a prison sentence for killing her newborn child, despite acknowledging her good behavior and progress in prison.

candidates.title: Ants Nõmper: How to legalize euthanasia in Estonia?
candidates.summary: I believe there are no credible arguments against holding a referendum on whether euthanasia should be permitted. Just as a competition is a celebration for athletes, a referendum is a celebration of democracy, writes Ants Nõmper.

candidates.title: Estonia's defense minister: The Gulf of Finland has not become more dangerous
candidates.summary: Defense Minister Martin Herem said recent drone attacks on Russian ships have not made the Gulf of Finland more dangerous, adding that cleaning up the aftermath of Ukrainian strikes can be seen as part of supporting Ukraine.

candidates.title: Eesti Energia to lay off 343 employees
candidates.summary: State-owned energy company Eesti Energia will issue layoff notices to 343 employees following the conclusion of collective redundancy consultations with workers and their representatives.

candidates.title: Finance minister: Rising energy prices are not unexpected and should not be compensated
candidates.summary: Rising energy prices are not unexpected because the government has repeatedly warned about them, and it would not be fair to compensate consumers who knowingly accepted price risks by choosing market-based energy contracts, Finance Minister Jürgen Ligi argues.

candidates.title: Estonia's London embassy raises €28,000 for Ukrainian hospital revamp
candidates.summary: The Estonian Embassy in London raised over €28,000 by hosting a charity reception to support the reconstruction of the intensive care unit at Ukraine's Berdychiv Hospital.

candidates.title: Opposition says it can muster 51 votes against social affairs minister
candidates.summary: Center Party lawmaker Anastassia Kovalenko-Kõlvart said opposition parties have already secured enough support to challenge Social Affairs Minister Karmen Joller and could submit a no-confidence motion within days.

candidates.title: Social affair minister does not plan to resign over family doctor duties controversy
candidates.summary: Social Affairs Minister Karmen Joller has apologized for failing to recognize a conflict of interest over retaining her family doctor patient list but insists she broke no laws and will not resign.

candidates.title: Ingmar Roos: State keeps subsidizing rail line that doesn't pay for itself
candidates.summary: Which is more important: 30 passengers on each Tartu-Riga train or a year's salary for 70 rescue workers? Why is the state continuing to subsidize the Tartu-Riga rail line when, by Elron's own assessment, it will not become financially viable in the foreseeable future and requires at least €2 million a year in subsidies, asks Ingmar Roos.

candidates.title: Alar Laneman: Estonia's decision to close the Russian border logical and unavoidable
candidates.summary: Closing Estonia's border with Russia will strengthen national security and reduce opportunities for hostile activities, while preserving open borders within the EU remains essential to European unity, Alar Laneman argues.

candidates.title: Gallery: Lasnamäe Pavilion opens new season with works by 500 artists
candidates.summary: A new season opened Saturday at the Tallinn Art Hall's Lasnamäe Pavilion with the exhibition "Te olete kõik oodatud" ("You Are All Welcome"), bringing together works by more than 500 artists.

candidates.title: Estonia's Competition Authority wants a bigger budget or lower fees for consumers
candidates.summary: Estonia's Competition Authority says millions collected from consumers through regulatory oversight fees are being diverted to other state budget expenses, leaving the agency underfunded and potentially facing layoffs.

candidates.title: Military officer: Destroying Kerch Bridge could significantly disrupt Russian military logistics
candidates.summary: Ukraine's attack on the Kerch Bridge damaged a key transportation link between occupied Crimea and Russia. Estonian Defense Forces Lt. Col. Taavi Liias says that if Ukraine succeeds in disabling the rail connection as well, it could significantly complicate Russian military logistics on the southern front.

candidates.title: Estonian PM: We need to get used to and be prepared for drone strikes over the Baltic
candidates.summary: According to Prime Minister Kristen Michal, Estonia must be prepared for Ukraine to continue attacking Russian ships in the Baltic Sea.

candidates.title: Saaremaa wants to improve apartment buildings' crisis preparedness
candidates.summary: Residents on the island of Saaremaa are continuing to boost crisis preparedness after being hit by several big storms in recent years, and want to make sure heating substations remain operational during power outages.

candidates.title: Estonia's startup sector is growing faster than the rest of the economy
candidates.summary: Estonia's startup sector is growing "significantly faster" than the rest of the economy, and high-profile layoffs do not reflect the sector as a whole, the Ministry of Economic Affairs has said.

candidates.title: Erakonnakaaslased näeksid Mihkel Leesi ministrina, ent mees ise kõhkleb
candidates.summary: Sotsiaalminister Karmen Jolleri tagasiastumise järel on Reformierakonna ridades käidud tema võimaliku mantlipärijana välja riigikogu liikme ja endise Tartu abilinnapea Mihkel Leesi nimi. Lees ministriametit ei välista, kuid teda paneb kõhklema riigikogu valimisteni jäänud napp aeg.

candidates.title: Lõpuks saabus selgus. Senegal sai pärast pikalt kestnud vaidlust tiitli tagasi
candidates.summary: Rahvusvaheline spordiarbitraažikohus (CAS) tühistas Aafrika jalgpalliliidu otsuse ja ennistas Senegali 2025. aasta Aafrika rahvuste karikavõistluste võitjaks.

candidates.title: Paldiskis ründas põhikoolitüdruk koolikaaslast noa ja haamriga. Vald: ründja jääb ajutiselt koduõppele
candidates.summary: Paldiskis asuvas Pakri koolis ründas teisipäeval kuuenda klassi tüdruk koolikaaslast noaga, kuid õnneks pääses rünnatud tütarlaps tõsisematest vigastustest. Lääne-Harju vallast kommenteeriti, et kooli suur tugipersonal on nõustanud nii õpilasi kui lapsevanemaid ning ründaja jääb kümneks päevaks koduõppele.

candidates.title: KUKU ⟩ Ülle Madise toetab Kersti Kaljulaidi ettepanekut tõsta riigikogulaste palk neljakordse eesti keskmiseni
candidates.summary: Kuku raadio saates «Mõjukate tund» rääkis vabariigi president Ülle Madise, et Eesti riigikaitsekulude planeerimisel tuleb säilitada paindlikkus, kuid kaitseks vajalike relvasüsteemide ja varustuse soetamist ei tohi teiste valdkondade rahastamise nimel edasi lükata.

candidates.title: Üürnik maksab, omanik tellib: kelle kanda peaks jääma maakleritasu?
candidates.summary: Üürikorteri otsimisega võivad kaasneda märkimisväärsed lisakulud, sealhulgas maakleritasu, mille suurus võib ulatuda ühe kuu üürisummani. Sageli jääb selle maksmine üürniku kohustuseks ka siis, kui maakleriteenuse on tellinud korteriomanik. Kuigi seadus näeb üldjuhul ette, et teenuse eest tasub selle tellija, võimaldab see osapooltel kokku leppida ka teisiti.

candidates.title: JEEMENI SÕDA ⟩ Huthide pealetung Adenile tugevdab Iraani positsiooni ja võib vallandada uue naftahindade tõusu
candidates.summary: Huthi mässulised on viimastel kuudel korduvalt teatanud rünnakutest Saudi Araabia energiataristule, sulgenud Punase mere saudide tankeritele ja asunud pealetungile Adeni suunas, et võtta rahvusvaheliselt tunnustatud valitsuselt kontroll selle sadama üle.

candidates.title: NUNNUBIIL: prantslaste uus elektrisõiduk võlub välimuse ja hinnaga
candidates.summary: Prantsuse tootja Kilow tuli välja taskukohase elektrilise tarbesõidukiga La Bagnole, mis meenutab maasturi ja vormelauto ristandit. Omapärase välimusega kahekohalist masinat pakutakse nii mopeedauto kui ka kiirema variandina ning selle hind algab umbes 11 000 eurost.

candidates.title: JUHTKIRI ⟩ Kiusaja ei talu, kui talle vastu hakatakse
candidates.summary: Vene välisministeeriumi reaktsioon Eesti otsusele sulgeda Eesti-Vene piiripunktid on osa tavapärasest propagandasõjast. Säilitage rahu ja tegutsege tavapäraselt.

candidates.title: Keelu alt vabanenud ja katsevõistlused võitnud Soome suusataja ei pääsenud MK-etapile
candidates.summary: Mõned aastad tagasi dopinguga patustanud, kuid pärast võistluskeelust vabanemist taas tippsporti naasnud Soome suusataja ei pääsenud eeloleval nädalavahetusel Ruka MK-etapile.

candidates.title: OOTAMATU SEOS ⟩ See lapsena õpitud füüsiline oskus tõstab oluliselt vaimset võimekust
candidates.summary: Kui pere eelarve pitsitab, on laste tasulised huviringid sageli esimesed, millest loobutakse. Mahukas teadustöö paljastab aga, et ühest konkreetsest treeningust kõrvalejäämine võib mõjutada lapse tulevikku palju enam, kui vanemad arvatagi oskavad – ja seda lausa koolipingis.

candidates.title: Silvia Ilves: ma ei ole kullakaevaja ja mulle meeldib, et meil ei ole peres laristamist
candidates.summary: Tšellist Silvia Ilves on aastaid olnud enim kõneainet pakkuvate Eesti kuulsuste seas ning oma eraelu ja tegemiste jagamisega ta just kitsi ei ole. Abikaasa kohta rõhutab ta, et sai tema rikkusest teada alles hiljem, ning ta pole kindlasti n-ö kullakaevaja.

candidates.title: ÄRA VISKA ÄRA ⟩ Pagar avaldab nipi, kuidas leedikutega nakatunud jahu päästa
candidates.summary: Jahuleedikud on tõeline nuhtlus. Piisab vaid ühest nakatunud jahupakist, et kutsumata külalised leviksid üle terve kodu. Kui märkame leedikuid, viskame kuivainete paki tavaliselt pikemalt mõtlemata prügikasti. Kuid kas see on tingimata vajalik? Kogenud pagar selgitab, kuidas kahjurid teraviljatoodetesse satuvad ning kuidas tema praktikas selle probleemiga toime tuleb. Mõni nõuanne võib lausa üllatada.

candidates.title: Politsei pidas kinni prints Williami ja printsess Kate’i maamõisa sisse murdnud mehed
candidates.summary: Politsei pidas kinni kaks meest, keda kahtlustatakse sissemurdmises prints Williami ja printsess Catherine’i maamõisa Norfolki krahvkonnas.

candidates.title: Rahanduskomisjon tahab pidurdada hasartmängumaksu langetamist
candidates.summary: Riigikogu rahanduskomisjon algatas hasartmängumaksu seaduse ja teiste seaduste muutmise seaduse eelnõu, millega sätestatakse, et lähimal kolmel aastal astmeliselt jõustuma planeeritud hasartmängumaksu määrad jäävad alates 1. juulist 2027 samale tasemele kui 2026. aastal ehk 5,5 protsendile.

candidates.title: SELGITUS ⟩ Miks jäi nii palju mängijaid korvpallikoondisest eemale?
candidates.summary: Kui eelmise nädala lõpus avaldati Eesti meeste korvpallikoondisega käesolevaks MM-valiksarja aknaks liitunud mängijate nimekiri, puudus sealt mõni nädal varem avaldatud esialgse nimekirjaga võrreldes koguni kaheksa mängijat. Millised on nende eemalejäämise põhjused?

candidates.title: ARVUSTUS ⟩ Kupleeguru Olaf Kopvillem eesti kultuuri pühaks ei pidanud
candidates.summary: Austraalias tegutsev eesti elektroonilise pärimusmuusika pioneer Olev Muska andis legendaarse väliseesti kupleeguru ja satiiriku Olaf Kopvillemi 100. sünniaastapäevaks välja täispika albumi «Tšimmairuudiralla».

candidates.title: ÜLEVAADE ⟩ Börsid taastuvad eufooriast, aktsiad on langusesse pöördunud
candidates.summary: Jensen Huangi naasmisele Nvidia tegevjuhi kohale järgnes aktiate erakordne tõusulaine. Eufooria on teisipäevaks aga vaibunud ning püsib kahtlus, kas tehisaruga seotud aktsiad suudavad oma tõusu hoida.

candidates.title: Pipedrive’i kärpekirves tabab Tartus enam kui pooli töötajaid
candidates.summary: Kui oktoobri lõpus avalikkuse ette jõudnud koondamiskava järgi ähvardas müügitarkvarafirmas Pipedrive töökaotus ligi kolmveerandit Tartu kontori töötajatest, siis töötukassa värsketel andmetel kujuneb koondamine esialgu kardetust mõnevõrra väiksemaks.

candidates.title: Aga ehk hakkate väljaheitedoonoriks – tulusam kui vere annetamine ja selle taga on uskumatu lugu
candidates.summary: Väljaheite siirdamine on tõusnud meditsiinis lootustandvaks ravimeetodiks, kuid tervete ja sobivate doonorite leidmine on erakordselt keeruline. Range sõela läbivad vaid üksikud inimesed, kelle rikkalik soole mikrobioom võib pakkuda leevendust raskete haiguste korral.

candidates.title: ANALÜÜS ⟩ Pillak ja Lees on valmis ministriametit kaaluma. Kumbagi võib Michalil aga riigikogus vaja minna
candidates.summary: Kaks reformierakondlast – riigikogu fraktsiooni esimees Õnne Pillak ja aseesimees Mihkel Lees – on avalikult öelnud, et kui neile pakutaks sotsiaalministri kohta, oleksid nad valmis seda kaaluma. Võib arutada, mida «olen valmis kaaluma» poliitiku suus tähendab, aga üks tõlgendus on lihtne – olen valmis.

candidates.title: Üle pika aja suures rollis Henri Drell: Leedu naised on ilusad, aga proovin probleemidest hoiduda
candidates.summary: Eesti korvpallikoondise üks liidreid Henri Drell leidis Leedust laias plaanis selle, mida ta sinna otsima läks.

candidates.title: FOTO SÜNDMUSKOHALT ⟩ Tallinna kesklinnas süttis suure leegiga hoovis auto
candidates.summary: Teisipäeva pärastlõunal süttis Tallinna kesklinnas Mere puiesteel hoovis sõiduauto.

candidates.title: Petrooleumi tänav saab sõiduteest eraldatud kõnni- ja rattateed
candidates.summary: Tallinnas on valminud Petrooleumi tänava ümberehitamise põhiprojekt, mille järgi rajatakse mõlemale poole tänavat sõiduteest eraldatud kõnni- ja rattateed, uuendatakse sõiduteed ning istutatakse tänava äärde puid ja põõsaid.

candidates.title: VIDEO JA PILDID ⟩ Taasavatud Sõpruse silla esimesed ületajad said linnapealt šokolaadi
candidates.summary: Head kasutamist! Nii soovis Tartu linnapea Urmas Klaas esimestele autojuhtidele, kes Sõpruse silla vastavatud poolt ületasid, ja kinkis tahvli šokolaadi. Mõni minut pärast kella 14 oli Tartu taristuehituse teenistuse juhataja Kaido Ivask eest tõstnud «telliskivi» liiklusmärgi. Sellega taastus silla mõlemal poolel autoliiklus kahel rajal, aga lisaks on ka kummalgi sillapoolel lai kõnnitee ja rattarada.

candidates.title: Rovaniemi keskuse juht: teravnenud tähelepanu Arktikale pole sugugi ainult hea
candidates.summary: Maailma pilgud pöörduvad viimasel ajal üha enam põhja ja see pole sugugi ainult hea, ütleb Soome Arktika keskuse uus juht, kelle sõnul domineerivad Arktika-teemalistes aruteludes geopoliitilised pinged, kuid kliima soojenemine pole teadusuuringute päevakorrast siiski kadunud.

candidates.title: Eilne ralli pidurdus. Nvidia aktsia jätkab kukkumist
candidates.summary: Pärast esmaspäevast tormilist tõusu pöördus Nvidia aktsia teisipäeval enam kui 8% langusesse.

candidates.title: Viljandimaa edukaimaks ettevõtteks sai üle 30 aasta tegutsenud kontsern
candidates.summary: Viljandimaa ettevõtete TOPi kinni pannud Vestman Energia tegevuse alussammasteks on metsa- ja põllumaa haldamine, lisaks on üle 30 aasta tegutsenud kontsern investeerinud energeetikasse, kinnisvarasse ning idufirmadesse.

candidates.title: Minister ja juhatuse liige – milles probleem?
candidates.summary: Lepime kokku, et ministri kuulumine näiteks omaenda investeerimisfirma juhatusse on okei, kirjutab Äripäev juhtkirjas.

candidates.title: Edukas metallitööstus koondas kaks juhti, omanik hoiatab ärevate aegade eest
candidates.summary: Metallitööstus Radius Machining koondas seitse inimest, kuna otsib seoses tellimuste vähenemisega efektiivsust. Kärbiti ka müügijuhi ja personalijuhi ametikohad.

candidates.title: Eilne eufooria asendus langusega, investorid seedivad Huangi naasmist
candidates.summary: USA aktsiaturud jätkasid teisipäevast kauplemispäeva langusega, võttes hoo maha pärast eilset tõusurallit. Investorid analüüsivad nüüd Nvidia juhi tagasitulekut ja uusi võimalikke intressitõuse.

candidates.title: Rahanduskomisjon tõmbab hasartmängumaksu langetamisele pidurit: riik loodab suuremat maksutulu
candidates.summary: Riigikogu rahanduskomisjon algatas eelnõu, et peatada kaughasartmängu maksumäära kavandatud langetamine.

candidates.title: GALERII | Bolt avas noortele juhtidele uksed
candidates.summary: Äripäeva noorte juhtide klubi külastas möödunud neljapäeval, 19. novembril Bolti peakontorit, kus kohtuti ettevõtte kaasasutaja Martin Villiguga. Lisaks tutvuti Bolti tõukerataste arendamise telgitagustega.

candidates.title: Ryanair annab AI hoolde üha rohkem ülesandeid
candidates.summary: Tehisintellekt aitab lennunduses ennustada turbulentsi, säästa kütust ja teenindada reisijaid. Ryanair võtab AI abi üha enam kasutusse, nagu ka mitmed teised suured lennufirmad.

candidates.title: Valitsus langetab võrgutasusid ja teeb talveks küttehüvitise
candidates.summary: Rahandusministeeriumi vastuseisust hoolimata sai valitsuses põhimõttelise heakskiidu plaan algaval kütteperioodil energiahindu tarbijatele hüvitada.

candidates.title: Küberpettur ei otsi rumalat inimest, vaid pinges töötajat
candidates.summary: Pettuse ohvriks võivad langeda nõukogu liige, pearaamatupidaja ja küberohtudest teadlik töötaja, sest pettur ei otsi rumalat inimest, vaid loob olukorra, kus tark inimene teeb halva otsuse, ütles psühholoog Erik Rüütel.

candidates.title: Vilepuhumine audiitorite tähelepanu all: e-posti aadressist üksi ei piisa
candidates.summary: Alates 2025. aasta algusest peab igal 50 või enama töötajaga ettevõttel ja enamikul avaliku sektori asutustest olema asutusesisene teavituskanal. Paljudes organisatsioonides on selleks loodud eraldi e-posti aadress. WhistleHub äriarendusjuhi Kertu Veileri sõnul nõuab toimiv vilepuhumisprogramm aga enamat. Alates 2027. majandusaastast pööravad vilepuhumise korraldusele senisest enam tähelepanu ka audiitorid.

candidates.title: Tagasi astunud Joller pole ainus, ka Michal rikkus sama seadust
candidates.summary: Sotsiaalminister Karmen Joller pole ainus, kes on valitsuse liikmena kuulunud ettevõtte juhatusse. Ka peaminister Kristen Michalil läks kuu, enne kui ta kliimaministriks saades oma ettevõtte juhatusest lahkus.

candidates.title: Liivamäed näevad küberturvalisuses mitme aasta võimalust
candidates.summary: USA majanduse kasvufaasi jätkumine on investor Kristjan Liivamäe põhistsenaarium järgmiseks aastaks, kuid suurimaks ohuks peab ta sündmuste ahelat, mis sunniks keskpanku intresse tõstma.

candidates.title: Eksperdid: Huangi naasmine tõi börsile kergenduse, kuid riskid jäid
candidates.summary: Analüütikute hinnangul aitas esmaspäevasele börsirallile kaasa tehnoloogiaaktsiate ülemüük, kuid mitu tehisintellektisektori tulevikku puudutavat küsimust on endiselt vastuseta.

candidates.title: Leedu keskpankur ärgitab Euroopat ennetavalt intresse tõstma
candidates.summary: Detsembris kogunev Euroopa Keskpanga nõukogu peaks ennetavalt tõstma praeguseid intressimäärasid, et senine inflatsioon ei muutuks püsivaks, leiab Leedu keskpanga president Gediminas Šimkus.

candidates.title: Anthropicu aktsia kukkus eelturul alla IPO-hinna
candidates.summary: Möödunud neljapäeval ajaloo suurima aktsiate esmase avaliku pakkumise teinud tehisintellektifirma Anthropicu aktsia langes teisipäeval eelturul allapoole 83dollarilist märkimishinda.

candidates.title: Volkswagen alustab täna palgaläbirääkimisi
candidates.summary: Saksamaa autotootja Volkswagen alustab täna oma mõjuka töötajate esindusega palgaläbirääkimisi, mida saadavad protestid ja streigiähvardused.

candidates.title: Sten-Patrick Kreek: kriisis võib raha lõppeda enne toitu
candidates.summary: Toidujulgeolek ei tähenda laovarude kogumist. Kriisis peab toimima kogu süsteem, kirjutab regionaal- ja põllumajandusministeeriumi kriisijuhtimise nõunik Sten-Patrick Kreek.

candidates.title: Loverte juht: Eesti e‑kaubanduses läheb uue kliendi leidmine üha raskemaks
candidates.summary: Kuigi Eesti e-kaubanduse olukord on hea, muudavad rahvusvahelised konkurendid kohalike kaupmeeste elu järjest keerulisemaks, rääkis ilutoodete e-poe Loverte tegevjuht Aivo Joost.

candidates.title: Tallinna loomaaia juht lahkub
